name: catch fish

text: Two fish, flapping on the sand.
Two fish, one on each strike.
Two fish thrash on the sand.
One fish, wriggling on the point.
A single fish. Enough for now.
Nothing. The fish are quicker than you.
The water swirls. The spear comes up empty.

log: You wade into the shallows, spear raised.
You stand knee-deep in the cold water and wait.
Spear ready, you wade out slowly.
